slices.title: Vite vanilla JS scaffold + CSP + Pages workflow
slices.dispatchText:
SLICE GRAFIK-01-SCAFFOLD

Project grafik_to, root G:\_Grafik_TO (git, branch main, NO remote yet, no push).
Spec (authoritative, Russian): G:\_Grafik_TO\docs\spec\TZ.md. Read sections 2, 3 and 7 only for this slice.
Delegate implementation to a cheap L3 worker; you review its diff and run the checks yourself.

Goal: static Vite + vanilla JS (ES modules) scaffold for GitHub Pages, browser-only.
1. REMOVE the wrong placeholder stack: CMakeLists.txt, src/main.cpp, resources/resources.qrc, empty include/.
2. package.json (private, type=module), deps: xlsx (SheetJS, install from the official CDN tarball
   https://cdn.sheetjs.com/ as SheetJS docs recommend; check current docs via Context7), exceljs.
   devDeps: vite, vitest, eslint (flat config eslint.config.js), prettier.
   scripts: dev, build, preview, test (vitest run), lint, verify = lint && test && build.
3. vite.config.js: base './' (works under any GitHub Pages repo name), build to dist/.
4. index.html (lang=ru): header, settings panel placeholder, drop zone placeholder, 4 tab placeholders
   (График ТО, Детализация, Исключенные записи, Сводка по месяцам), status line.
   Privacy guard: <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> with default-src 'self';
   connect-src 'self' https://isdayoff.ru; no external scripts/fonts/analytics.
5. src/styles/tokens.css (colors, spacing, radius, font stack, focus ring) + src/styles/main.css (compact layout).
6. src/main.js entry; src/modules/{parser,calendarService,scheduler,exporter,ui}.js stubs with one named
   export each; public/calendar/ (empty .gitkeep, fallback JSON comes in a later slice).
7. tests/smoke.test.js: imports every module stub; one test asserting index.html contains the CSP meta.
8. .github/workflows/deploy.yml: on push to main -> npm ci, npm run verify, actions/upload-pages-artifact (dist),
   actions/deploy-pages. Use current official Pages actions (check docs).
9. .gitignore (node_modules, dist, coverage), README.md (RU: purpose, privacy note, dev/build/test, deploy).
10. Rewrite docs/context/INDEX.md for the web stack (keep the resume marker line).

Verify (verify=off; L0 re-runs this exact command):
  npm ci --prefix G:\_Grafik_TO && npm --prefix G:\_Grafik_TO run verify
Report to architect :22601: STATUS done|failed, commit, changed files, verify result. EN <=10 lines. No push.
verifyCommands: npm ci --prefix G:\_Grafik_TO && npm --prefix G:\_Grafik_TO run verify
slices.retro: Vite scaffold, CSP, Pages workflow; L3 mis-rooted output, relocated by orch1.

slices.title: Owner fixes D11-D14: phys threshold+bug, Bez TO=*, winter load
slices.dispatchText:
SLICE=GRAFIK-10-FIXES project=grafik_to root=G:\_Grafik_TO verify=off (send DONE+raw evidence to architect)
Goal: owner acceptance fixes. Spec: docs/spec/decisions.md D11-D14 (authoritative, override TZ.md and earlier D1/D5).
1) D11 configurable physical-person threshold (setting, default 3) + FIX bug: physical persons with 3 units appear in schedule on real export. Find root cause (physical detection on `Группа владельца` values, counting only post-filter units, owner key). Tests for 2/3/4 units, modes A and B; D5 note uses threshold.
2) D12 `Без ТО`="*" = overdue, must be scheduled (remove it from exclusion reasons); depth D1 still applies; other exclusions win.
3) D13 "*" with empty/invalid `Дата ТО` = treated as >5 years old: included only if depth>=5, else excluded with reason.
4) D14 winter months setting (default Dec/Jan/Feb) + winter load % (0-100, default 30) weighting least-loaded month choice for overdue and "*" units; fixed target dates untouched.
UI settings + localStorage for new fields; update README settings table; update tests/fixtures (make-fixture) to cover "*" cases.
Done = npm run verify green, commits on main, push to origin (Pages redeploy), confirm Actions run success + Pages HTTP 200.
Report: STATUS(done) commit(s), files, test count, Actions run id, root cause of bug 1 (1 line). No acks.

slices.title: User manual RU, plain language (docs/manual.md)
slices.dispatchText:
SLICE=GRAFIK-11-MANUAL project=grafik_to root=G:\_Grafik_TO verify=off (send DONE+raw evidence to architect)
Goal: user manual in Russian for a non-technical office user. New file docs/manual.md only (+ one link line in README). Do NOT touch src/, tests/, package files: orch1 is editing them in GRAFIK-10-FIXES in the same repo.
Sources: docs/spec/TZ.md, docs/spec/decisions.md (D1-D14, authoritative), actual UI labels in src/ (quote labels exactly as on screen), live app https://wwwmanager.github.io/Grafik_TO/.
Style: plain everyday Russian, short sentences, step-by-step numbered actions. No jargon (no "парсер", "кэш", "API", "CORS", "localStorage", "чанк", "фильтр" in tech sense); explain terms when unavoidable.
Content: what the program does and does not do; what you need (browser, export file from the registry); step-by-step: open site, load file, check settings, build, review preview tabs, download Excel; every setting: what it means, default, when to change, example; how to read each of the 4 result sheets; why a unit was excluded (each reason in plain words, incl. "Без ТО" = "*" means overdue and IS scheduled); physical persons threshold; winter months load; calendar message (online vs built-in); privacy: file is processed only on the user's computer, nothing is sent; common problems and fixes; short FAQ.
GRAFIK-10 adds settings (D11 threshold, D14 winter months/%). Draft now; before reporting, wait until a GRAFIK-10 commit appears in git log and re-check labels against src/.

slices.title: Group small owners (≤N) by latest TO date
slices.dispatchText:
SLICE=GRAFIK-14-GROUP-SMALL project=grafik_to root=G:\_Grafik_TO verify=off (send DONE to architect)
Goal: new feature per owner — group small owners by latest TO date.
Feature: when an owner (physical or legal) has ≤ N units of equipment after all filters, optionally group ALL those units into ONE visit on the date of the LATEST TO among them (i.e. the maximum target date of that owner's units), instead of scheduling each unit on its own target date.
UI: new setting "Группировать малых владельцев (≤N ед.) по последней дате ТО" (checkbox, default ON). N = same "Порог физлиц, ед. техники" setting (D11). Applies to ALL owners with unit count ≤ N, not only physical persons.
Behaviour: if ON and owner's post-filter unit count ≤ N:
- compute max target date among that owner's units;
- create ONE visit for that owner on that date (respecting grouping window, winter weighting if overdue, etc.);
- all units of that owner go into that visit; Details sheet shows all units with their individual original target dates.
If OFF (or count > N): current behaviour — each unit on its own target date, possibly clustered by window.
Update: scheduler.placement logic; exporter sheet 1 & 2 to show single visit row with multiple units; preview tabs; tests covering ON/OFF, 1/2/3/4 units, mixed physical/legal, overdue + normal dates, winter months.
verify: npm run verify green. Commit, push origin main (Pages redeploy). Confirm Actions run + Pages 200.
Report: STATUS(done) commit, files, test count, Actions run id. No acks.
slices.retro: group small owners by latest TO date, checkbox ON by default

slices.title: Geo fix: bare cities, attached markers, region markers
slices.dispatchText:
SLICE=GRAFIK-15-GEO-FIX project=grafik_to root=G:\_Grafik_TO verify=off (send DONE to architect)
Goal: fix geo extraction so "— / —" stops appearing for real export addresses.
Root causes (from test):
1. "г.Москва" (no space) — regex requires space after marker.
2. Bare city names "Москва" — no marker, not recognized.
3. Region markers missing: "обл.", "область", "край", "АО", "респ.", "округ" — district not recognized.
Fix in src/modules/scheduler.js extractLocation():
- Handle marker attached to name: if part starts with marker+name without space (e.g., "г.Москва"), split after marker.
- Heuristic for bare settlement: if first part has no marker but looks like a city name (capitalized word, not a street type), treat as settlement.
- Add region markers to district detection: "обл.", "область", "край", "АО", "респ.", "республика", "округ", "аобл".
- Keep backward compatibility; all existing tests pass.
Update: SETTLEMENT_MARKERS, DISTRICT_MARKERS arrays; extractLocation logic; unit tests for all cases above + edge cases.
verify: npm run verify green. Commit, push origin main (Pages redeploy). Confirm Actions run + Pages 200.
Report: STATUS(done) commit, files, test cases added, Actions run id. No acks.
slices.retro: bare cities, attached markers, region fallback district

slices.title: Parser: build address from split columns (region/district/settlement/street/house)
slices.dispatchText:
SLICE=GRAFIK-16-ADDR-COLUMNS project=grafik_to root=G:\_Grafik_TO verify=off (send DONE to architect)
Goal: parser reads address from split columns in real export (region/район/населённый пункт/улица/дом in separate cols), not just single "Адрес владельца".
Real export format (owner sample):
  Col A: ЧЕЛЯБИНСКАЯ ОБЛ (region, marker ОБЛ/ОБЛАСТЬ/КРАЙ/АО/РЕСП)
  Col B: КУСИНСКИЙ Р-Н (district, marker Р-Н/РАЙОН) or empty
  Col C: КУСА Г / ЗЛАТОУСТ Г / МЕДВЕДЕВКА С / ТАЙНАК П / ЦЕНТРАЛЬНЫЙ п (settlement, marker Г/С/П/ПГТ/Д/Х/СТ-ЦА/АУЛ/РП)
  Col D..: street, house, etc.
Parser must:
1. After finding header row, scan ALL header cells for address-part markers:
   - region: header contains ОБЛ, ОБЛАСТЬ, КРАЙ, АО, РЕСП, РЕСПУБЛИКА, ОКРУГ
   - district: header contains Р-Н, РАЙОН
   - settlement: header contains Г, С, П, ПГТ, Д, Х, СТ-ЦА, АУЛ, РП (as whole word or suffix)
2. For each row, concatenate non-empty values from these columns in order: region, district, settlement, street, house → full address string.
3. Fallback: if "Адрес владельца" column exists and non-empty, use it (current behaviour).
4. Pass combined address to extractLocation() (already fixed in GRAFIK-15 for bare cities, attached markers, region markers).
Update: src/modules/parser.js (header scan + address assembly), tests for split-column format.
verify: npm run verify green. Commit, push origin main (Pages redeploy). Confirm Actions run + Pages 200.
Report: STATUS(done) commit, files, test cases, Actions run id. No acks.
slices.retro: split address columns parsed, settlement markers stripped
